Travel meal expenses Policy
Jan Peeters, HR Advisor (left company 2023)
2023-09-18  v1.2

[Slide 2]
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on travel meal expenses at Vandenberg Logistics NV.

[Slide 3]
Policy
Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to EUR 45 per day.

[Slide 4]
Validity
Version 1.2, effective 2021-07-01. Next review: 2024-09-17.
